claims.claim: Intersect's Technical Steering Committee requests 1,193,000 ADA, described as $298,250, for 12 months of support activities.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The requested amount does not, at submission, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with named addresses and permission thresholds disclosed.
The TSC has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

The proposal claims TSC work is foundational technical governance capacity that supports Cardano's strategy pillars, including uptime, DRep participation, governance quality, and ecosystem resilience.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect TSC support, split across three work packages, with disclosed smart-contract custody, oversight permissions, voting-process references, NCL compliance claims, and external assurance, while several impact claims remain proposer assertions.
